fields.description: Issue dated June 23, 1928, featuring editorials and commentary on Miami’s response to “Scarface” Al Capone’s presence and public-safety concerns, including a reprinted summary of Capone’s record from the Chicago Tribune. Additional coverage includes local police-department politics and criticism of efforts to undermine the police administration; Coral Gables municipal politics and disputes involving the city commission and George Merrick; discussion of Prohibition enforcement and reports of poisonous/illicit liquor; local business and civic development (including a letter from the Greater Miami Manufacturers Association); and consumer/city-life items such as taxi fares, sanitation/odor complaints, and society columns and advertisements.
